name: The Borrowed Grove
introDiscord:
The grove looks familiar.

Too familiar.

Roots repeat in identical patterns, the same stone appears three times,
and one of Shizuki's old trail signs has somehow reproduced.
introTwitch:
The grove looks familiar.

Too familiar.

Roots repeat in identical patterns, the same stone appears three times,
and one of Shizuki's old trail signs has somehow reproduced.

the-borrowed-grove-approach.prompt:
Three paths pass through scenery that repeats with unsettling
precision.

left.message:
Broad silver kelp wraps a Star Candy cache.

Five feet away is an identical bundle.

The second bundle has teeth.

You select the first.

right.message:
A moonblossom pool rests beside two identical Shizuki notes.

One reads:

'REAL MEDICINE.'

The other reads:

'REAL MEDICIN.'

The typo saves lives.
right.fullHpMessage:
You leave the real medicine untouched and continue appreciating the
Mimic's imperfect spelling.

forward.message:
A perfect copy of a tree opens its eyes.

Ancient Grove Mimic.

Tree privileges revoked.

the-borrowed-grove-depths.prompt:
Moonlit fronds surround three nearly identical routes. Every landmark
appears at least twice.

left.message:
A root ahead looks exactly like the previous root.

Because it IS the previous root's Mimic.

This forest has become aggressively derivative.

right.message:
One Berry sits beneath two copies of Shizuki's note.

The real one says:

'Found Mimic copying my handwriting.

I feel artistically threatened.'

The fake says:

'I feel artly threated.'

Needs practice.

forward.message:
A shrine coffer rests beside an identical fake coffer.

You choose the one with a latch instead of gums.

Experience pays off.

the-borrowed-grove-threshold.prompt:
Towering kelp closes around Imitation Heartwood. Three routes look
identical down to the same drifting leaves.

left.message:
An offering basket contains Star Candies.

A second offering basket watches you open it.

You politely ignore the second basket.

right.message:
Shizuki's trail sign points toward a root.

The sign blinks.

The sign is a Mimic.

This is getting ridiculous.

forward.message:
Restorative sap waits beside Shizuki's final authentication method:

'REAL NOTE HAS STAR DOODLE.'

There are four notes.

Every one now has a star doodle.

The Mimics learned.
forward.fullHpMessage:
You leave the restorative sap untouched and accept that the document
verification system has collapsed.

boss-antechamber.name: Imitation Heartwood
boss-antechamber.prompt:
Every duplicated object in the Grove begins moving toward the same
tree.

bossPromptDiscord:
The copies merge.

Fake roots, fake stones, fake shrines, fake signs, and fragments of
borrowed scenery flow into Imitation Heartwood.

The enormous tree changes shape again and again, unable—or unwilling—to
choose one form.

Use /yes to enter Imitation Heartwood or /no to leave before it starts
copying you.
bossPromptTwitch:
The copies merge.

Fake roots, fake stones, fake shrines, fake signs, and fragments of
borrowed scenery flow into Imitation Heartwood.

The enormous tree changes shape again and again, unable—or unwilling—to
choose one form.

Use !yes to enter Imitation Heartwood or !no to leave before it starts
copying you.
bossRetreatText:
You retreat quickly.

For several seconds, another version of you appears in the moss behind
you.

Then disappears.

Absolutely not.

boss.revealText:
The Heartwood tears itself free, cycling through dozens of copied forms.

Many-Faced Grove Mimic reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Many-Faced Mimic collapses back into ordinary roots.

The duplicate scenery fades.

One fake Shizuki sign remains.

It reads:

'GUD LUCK.'

Keep practicing."
